content: #7 Is there any chance we could get LaTeX-style comments? Even just for lines starting with %, this would be very convenient. I would like to paste the LaTeX output of quiver into pages, which includes a link to edit the diagram in a comment. It’s a bit inconvenient to replace this comment with the syntax suggested in #2 each time.
